Biomechanics.subject: Applied Sciences
Biomechanics.question: The _____ was Study of the mechanics of biological systems.
Biomechanics.fact: Biomechanics is the study of the structure, function and motion of the mechanical aspects of biological systems using the methods of mechanics. Biomechanics is a branch of biophysics.

Biomechatronics.subject: Applied Sciences
Biomechatronics.question: The _____ was Interdisciplinary science integrating biology and mechatronics.

Biophysics.subject: Applied Sciences
Biophysics.question: The _____ was Interdisciplinary science.
Biophysics.fact: Biophysics is an interdisciplinary science that applies approaches and methods traditionally used in physics to study biological phenomena. Biophysics covers all scales of biological organization, from molecular to organismic and populations.
